# Freeze window end dates come from Finance in writing

## Decision Question

Who is the authority on when a billing freeze ends?

## Decision Outcome

Finance, in writing. A verbal date from any other party is treated as an estimate and does not move a cutover plan.

## Alternatives Considered

- Let the delivery team set a working assumption and correct later. Rejected: the last two slips both traced to a working assumption nobody revisited.

## Approved By

Priya Raghavan, engagement lead.

## Context

Steerco was planning cutover against a freeze end date that no one had ever received from Finance.
